in_marathi.name: Eshin
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Love and Beauty
in_marathi.long_meaning: Eshin हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Eshin is the Sanskrit name of the Hindu goddess of love, beauty, and fertility. She is also known as Manaswini, the goddess of the mind, and is believed to bestow wisdom and inner peace upon her devotees.
